title: VisionFindRequest
description: vision.find-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/index and of GET or POST /api/v1/find. `index` stores a scoped CLIP embedding for one of the caller's own items (`item_id`, optional `result_url`); `find` searches only the caller's own private index, by words (`q`) or by an example image. No public image index is ever built.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
